title: Kusanagi Nene — Feeling In Each Step〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: One, two, three. One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, this timing feels right...
Now I just need to focus on raising my legs a little higher.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My form's improved, but it's still not perfect...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I only have a few days left to practice here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I got to practice with everyone, participate in auditions with them and even help out with one of their quarterly performances...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So much happened, and it all just seemed to fly by in a flash...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm so glad that I got to train here.
Because if I didn't, I probably...)
<Hiya, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hi, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, we didn't know you were staying back late to practice.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Looks like you're working hard, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I just still haven't completely figured out the dance they taught us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It must be really hard...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Are you by chance going to be tested on it?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I just felt like practicing it some more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I managed to keep up with everyone during our lesson, but I'm still not happy with where I am...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I want to change that before the time comes to stop training here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see. You're working on things you're not even required to for class...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's so admirable of you, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You guys are blowing things way out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I just don't want to leave things unfinished, is all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I got a chance to train here, so I feel that I should give it everything I have before I cross the finish line.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Your eyes are totally on fire, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. In other words, this ended up being a very stimulating experience for you, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I really learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: About the value of pursuing the perfect performance, how to interact with the people you're competing for roles with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What it means to fight for a role like your life depends on it, and the frustration you feel when you fail...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I believe all of those things have allowed me to grow a ton as an actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everything I learned at Morinomiya has had a huge effect on me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Nene...>
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I think someone's coming...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no! We gotta hide!>

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Hi, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Imura? Mori? What are you two doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: We saw you practicing by yourself, so we decided to see what you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: What were you practicing just now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line: I see. You were practicing that dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
But I totally get why.
I mean, I hate to leave things unfinished too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You feel the same way, Imura?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: Yeah. Once I have an image in my head, I want to keep going until I'm able to match it.

rows.Speaker: Mori
rows.Line:
Would it be alright if I practiced with you?
There were actually a few things with this routine that were still bothering me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
Oh, can I also join in?
You can feel free to ask us if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Really? That's so kind of you...
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nene looks so happy.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Experience is one thing...
But I think she gained more than just that during her time at Morinomiya!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah☆>
